meta.title: PIXEL API
meta.description: Signs in with your PIXEL main-site account (api.ai-pixel.online) and mounts the account's groups and models as model sources, billing chats to the site wallet with no API key. Text, tool calls and image input are supported; images are forwarded to the selected group's upstream model and comprehension depends on that model. After installing, sign in under Settings → PIXEL API, then pick a group and model in the composer's model picker; a successful sign-in replaces that menu with a two-column layout (groups on the left with billing ratio and group ID, models on the right) for every model provider. The password is used for one sign-in and deleted from this machine right after; only the site-issued session is kept (about 30 days, then the password is required again). Group and model lists and the account balance are sent to the site, and chat content is relayed by the site to the selected model. Disabling the plugin removes these model sources immediately; existing session logs are unaffected. Troubleshooting: set debug: true in the plugin config to record control flow in ~/.dsh/pixel-api/debug.log (never any secret).
